encodingNote: height.png is 8-bit RGB: v = R*256 + G (B = 0), elevM = elevMinM + v / 65535 * (elevMaxM - elevMinM). A true 16-bit PNG would be truncated to 8 bits by browsers.

hillshade.storage: 8-bit value in R = G = B of an RGB PNG (WebKit alters grayscale PNGs on decode)
